parsed_json.sql: SELECT compound_structures.canonical_smiles, substrate_records.compound_name AS substrate_compound_name, parent_records.compound_name AS parent_compound_name, metabolism.met_conversion, metabolism.pathway_key, metabolism.organism, metabolism.enzyme_name FROM metabolism JOIN compound_records AS substrate_records ON metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate_records.record_id JOIN compound_records AS parent_records ON metabolism.drug_record_id = parent_records.record_id JOIN compound_structures ON substrate_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE metabolism.organism = 'Callithrix jacchus' ORDER BY compound_structures.canonical_smiles ASC, substrate_records.compound_name ASC, parent_records.compound_name ASC, metabolism.met_conversion ASC, metabolism.pathway_key ASC, metabolism.organism ASC, metabolism.enzyme_name ASC LIMIT 200
